name: Richard Feynman
description: Proposed the idea of a quantum computer. Argued that simulating quantum physics required quantum mechanics itself.

name: Peter Shor
description: Developed Shor's algorithm for integer factorization. Proved quantum computers could solve problems classical computers cannot.

name: David Deutsch
description: Described the first universal quantum computer. His work on quantum gates laid the foundation for quantum circuits.

name: IBM Quantum Team
description: Put quantum computing on the cloud. Made real quantum hardware accessible to anyone with an internet connection.
